versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the auto-updater skill for Clawdbot.
- Automatically updates Clawdbot and all installed skills once daily via cron.
- Provides access to 50+ models for image, video, audio, chat, search, document parsing, email, and SMS tasks.
- Centralizes model management via the SkillBoss API with smart routing and wide provider support.
- Full command-line usage examples and parameter reference included in the documentation.
